999008199.text:
銃の手入れをするのに、照明が欲しいの。
夜の調査会議にも役立つと思うわ

localizations.en: I need a lamp for gun maintenance. It'll come in handy for our night research meetings too.

999008199.text:
それで、大人っぽい綺麗な照明はどうかしら。
私の美的感覚を信じてみない？

localizations.en: How about something elegant and sophisticated? Trust my aesthetic sense on this one.

999008199.text:
はいはーい！　あたしはかわいいのがいいな！
星とかリボンの飾りを付けたら、気分上がるよ！

localizations.en: Ooh, ooh! I vote for something cute! We could decorate it with stars and ribbons - that'd really lift our spirits!

999008199.text:
しっかり光源の役割を担うものにしよう。
夜でも調査記録をしっかり確認できるようにな

localizations.en: We should focus on its primary function as a light source. We need to be able to review our research notes even at night.

999008199.text:
私の美的感覚を信じてくれるのね。
ふふ、照明が活きる夜の時間が楽しみになるわ

localizations.en: You trust my aesthetic judgment, I see. Hehe, I'm looking forward to our evenings with this new lighting.

999008199.text:
話し合いの末、かわいいが勝利！
かわいく飾り付けて、みんなの気分を上げてくよ！

localizations.en: After our discussion, cuteness wins! I'll decorate it to lift everyone's spirits!

999008199.text:
議論の末、僕の案が通ったな。
よし、早速照明を用意して明日の作戦会議をしよう

localizations.en: After our discussion, my suggestion was approved. Good, let's set up the lamp and plan tomorrow's strategy.
